# Title

Write a role-based report interpretation guide

## Problem

The README describes reports, but engineers, PMs, accessibility practitioners, and designers need different first questions when reviewing the same artifact.

## Motivation

Correct interpretation is part of preventing score anchoring and unsupported release decisions.

## Scope

Create one guide with a five-minute path for each role, a shared evidence checklist, and examples from the local fixture.

## Target files

- `docs/report-interpretation.md`
- `README.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- Each role starts from evidence and limitations.
- Scores are explained as assumptions, not grades.
- Accessibility and advisory findings have explicit review boundaries.
- Examples use only fixture artifacts and no fabricated adoption claims.

## Test requirements

Run formatting, link checks if available, and manually verify heading hierarchy and descriptive links.

## Labels

`documentation`, `mentor available`

## Difficulty

Beginner to intermediate.

## Mentoring notes

Draft one role section first for feedback. Product and accessibility review are welcome.

## Non-goals

New report UI, scoring changes, compliance guidance, or generic QA training.
